column1: # Tolbi indoors after Colosso: stranded tourists, broken trade routes, Babi Lighthouse, merchants, families, Mind Read and food inspections.

column3: Someone is baking Tolbi\npizza. The cheese is\nburning at the edges.{end_wait}
A pot of pasta is boiling.\nSomeone ought to take it\noff the fire.{end_wait}
Seafood pasta with olive\noil and basil. It smells\ngood enough to make you{page_break}hungry.{end_wait}
We closed our makeshift inn\nwhen Colosso ended. The\nmattresses are finally put{page_break}away.{end_wait}
We had a busy festival.\nPerhaps we'll use the\nearnings for a little{page_break}holiday.{end_wait}
I've made enough beds for a\nlifetime. Now I want\nsomeone else to cook my{page_break}meals for a change.{end_wait}
I'd like to travel, but\nSilk Road is blocked and\nthe ships won't sail. Not{page_break}much of a holiday.{end_wait}

We rented our home to
visitors and tried to leave
town. Now the roads are{page_break}closed and the ferries
aren't sailing.{end_wait}

The tourists are stranded.
Someone says a few strong
fighters could protect the{page_break}ships. The captain
disagrees.{end_wait}
When the ships sail again,\nwe're going straight to\nKalay. We've stayed here{page_break}long enough.{end_wait}
I heard there's a cave\nleading toward the far side\nof the Karagol. No one I've{page_break}asked knows the way.{end_wait}
Colosso was incredible. I\nkeep replaying the last\nmatch in my head.{end_wait}
Did you see that small\nfighter charge those huge\nmen? I didn't think he'd{page_break}last a minute.{end_wait}
The finalists were\nsomething to see. I don't\nknow how they kept fighting{page_break}after all those trials.{end_wait}
Watching Colosso was fun,\nbut I'd rather not find out\nhow it feels to be hit that{page_break}hard.{end_wait}
Mt. Aleph erupted and roads\nwere ruined. No wonder the\ncrowds were smaller than{page_break}usual.{end_wait}
What if the eruption drove\nthose creatures into the\nKaragol? Nobody knows where{page_break}they came from.{end_wait}
Those sparkling stones that\nfell after the eruption\ndidn't look like ordinary{page_break}rock to me.{end_wait}
Maybe the sea monsters were\nfrightened by the eruption.\nFrightened animals can be{page_break}dangerous.{end_wait}
They say work on Babi\nLighthouse will pick up now\nthat Colosso is over. I'd{page_break}like to see it finished.{end_wait}
Business is quiet after\nColosso. I'll take my stock\non the road until next{page_break}year.{end_wait}
I understand Babi wants a\nlighthouse, but why build\nit so far away in Gondowan?{end_wait}
There aren't many merchants\nnear Babi Lighthouse yet. I\ncould do well there if I{page_break}arrived early.{end_wait}
Did you come here from\nKalay?{end_now}
I'd make enough if they\nreopened Silk Road. Until\nthen, all my goods are{page_break}stuck here.{end_wait}

You're {actor_name:1}, aren't
you? I saw you in the
finals. I never expected{page_break}someone your size to do so
well.{end_wait}
Did all the finalists\nbecome Babi's guards? I\nthought only the winners{page_break}were offered positions.{end_wait}
I missed the finals. Mother\nsays a warrior named\n{actor_name:1} did something{page_break}remarkable.{end_wait}
Next year I'm going to\nwatch every match. I don't\ncare how early I have to{page_break}get up.{end_wait}

I thought we'd rest once
Colosso ended, but the
Kalay tourists are back.{page_break}The ships won't take them
home.{end_wait}
The visitors from the east\ncan't get back across the\nKaragol. Some have no money{page_break}left for rooms.{end_wait}
I worked harder after\nColosso than during it.\nEveryone who's stranded{page_break}seems to have come here.{end_wait}
Hey, what's that over\nthere?{end_wait}
Me? Excited? You must be\njoking.{end_now}
Oh. Hello there.{end_wait}
I'm fine. Just tired,\nthat's all.{end_wait}
You look like a warrior.\nWere you in Colosso, or\nonly there to watch?{end_now}
The chef missed Colosso,\nand now he takes his anger\nout on everyone in the{page_break}kitchen.{end_wait}
I tried to go home, but the\nport has stopped sailing.\nAfter the crossing here, I{page_break}almost can't blame them.{end_wait}
Colosso's over, but we're\nstill trapped on this side\nof the Karagol. Would they{page_break}sail if we offered to row?{end_wait}
We offered to help row, and\nthe captain still won't\nsail? What more can he{page_break}want?{end_wait}
We paid to cross the\nKaragol, and now they won't\ntake us back. How is that{page_break}fair?{end_wait}
When that man gets angry,\nit's better to leave him\nalone until he runs out of{page_break}words.{end_wait}
They called this their best\nroom. I would hate to see\nthe others.{end_wait}
Tolbi is dull now that\nColosso is done. I want to\ngo home.{end_wait}
You! I remember you from\nbefore Colosso. Did you end\nup fighting?{end_now}
I saw Colosso. If I have to\nwait a few more days to get\nhome, I can live with it.{end_wait}
The harbor is full of\npeople waiting for ships\nthat won't sail.{end_wait}
The inns are still packed\neven after Colosso. The\nowners look delighted.{end_wait}

Everyone's building Babi
Lighthouse instead of
fixing the road. These{page_break}visitors could be stranded
for weeks.{end_wait}
She hid whatever she found\nbehind that pile of\nrubbish. I don't think she{page_break}saw me watching.{end_wait}
The thing I found looks\njust like the one that man\nshowed me. I hope he{page_break}doesn't ask for it back.{end_wait}
I missed every match. The\nothers won't stop talking\nabout the finals, and I{page_break}can't bear hearing it.{end_wait}
Chef, enough! We know you\nmissed Colosso. You're not\nthe only one who had to{page_break}work!{end_wait}
I tried the eastern cave.\nIt's blocked, just as the\nguards warned. I had to{page_break}turn back.{end_wait}

That cave east of Gondowan
Passage is full of
boulders. Without a way to{page_break}move them, you won't get
through.{end_wait}
We paid for passage. Now\nthey want us to row the\nship ourselves? I hope{page_break}that's a joke.{end_wait}
The crew says we might sail\nif everyone helps row. My\nhusband has been{page_break}complaining ever since.{end_wait}
I can't stand another night\nat this inn. I'd pay for a\npalace room if they'd let{page_break}me.{end_wait}
If Mother bought me a\nsouvenir, at least I'd have\nsomething to do while we{page_break}wait.{end_wait}
That voyage was frightening\nenough. I won't complain if\nwe stay on land for a{page_break}while.{end_wait}
I'm coming back for Colosso\nnext year, even if I have\nto walk the whole way!{end_wait}
If the ships aren't\nsailing, you might as well\nenjoy Tolbi while you're{page_break}here.{end_wait}
You all saw Colosso. Stop\ncomplaining! I missed the\nentire festival and still{page_break}had to work.{end_wait}
